name: Scalloped Cheese
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Take three slices of bread, well buttered, first cutting off the brown outside crust.
Grate fine any kind of good cheese; lay the bread in layers in a buttered baking-dish, sprinkle over each the grated cheese, some salt and pepper to taste.
Mix well-beaten eggs with milk; pour it over the bread and cheese.
Bake it in a hot oven as you would cook a bread pudding. This makes an ample dish for four people.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Take three slices of bread, well buttered, first cutting off the brown outside crust.
2. Grate fine any kind of good cheese; lay the bread in layers in a buttered baking-dish, sprinkle over each the grated cheese, some salt and pepper to taste.
3. Mix well-beaten eggs with milk; pour it over the bread and cheese.
4. Bake it in a hot oven as you would cook a bread pudding. This makes an ample dish for four people.
